frases.texto: Almost no low clouds: the sun will be clearly visible on the horizon.
Few low clouds: the horizon will be fairly clear.
Low clouds now and then: the sun may be hidden for a while.
Lots of low clouds: they are likely to cover the sun near the horizon.
Very overcast low sky: little gap to see the sun.
A good amount of mid or high clouds: these are the ones that turn orange and pink.
Almost no high clouds: the sky will be pretty but without much color.
Very overcast high sky: the colors will look dull.

vetos.motivo: Heavy rain is expected at sunrise.
The low sky is almost completely closed: you won't see the sun rise on the horizon.

nieblaVentaja.frase: Low fog or mist: you won't see the sun rise, but the soft light and the fog can make for very beautiful photos.

resumenes.verde: Good mix of clouds and no significant rain. Worth getting up early.
resumenes.ambar: There is a chance, but something is working against it. If you go, have a plan B (silhouettes, clouds, blue hour).
resumenes.rojo: The factors are against it. Better to go with a plan B (details, reflections, black and white) or stay home.
resumenes.tormenta: With a thunderstorm you can go out, but only with caution. The score depends on what the clouds let you see.

avisoNiebla: Low visibility (fog): you won't see the sun rise, but an estuary in morning fog can make for great photos.
